scope: Manufacturer specifications, indicative EU prices and reproducible electrical/inertial calculations. No native simulations, purchases, physical validation or model promotion were performed in this research lane.
sourcePolicy: Electrical specifications come from manufacturer documents. Distributor prices are observations retrieved on the review date, sometimes from indexed/cached regional pages, and are not live order promises. All prices exclude VAT and shipping. Package suffixes and quantity breaks are preserved.

candidates.role: Existing fast analog reference; two parts for planar, three for general 3D inertia reconstruction
candidates.noiseDensityConditions: 100 Hz to 10 kHz; 1/f corner 0.1 Hz; typical manufacturer noise, not assembled sanding noise

response.interpretation: Bandwidth points arise from resonant gain increase, not a first-order 11 kHz low-pass. The external engineered AA transfer is a separate design choice.

calibration.ratiometric: Sensitivity scales with VDD; zero-g output is VDD/2.
calibration.interpretation: Do not convert the 5 g max-minus-min temperature excursion into an assumed constant linear drift. Initial and warm tare, scale, axis and temperature calibration are required.

candidates.role: Least disruptive cheaper 3-axis analog architecture; lower internal bandwidth and smaller range require qualification
candidates.noiseDensityConditions: +/-8 g noise is estimated by design as 50% above +/-2 g, not a measured maximum guarantee.

response.internalAnalogFilterDescription: Sinc-shaped analog antialias response, approximately 1.5 kHz -3 dB. Rev D does not state a complete order/impulse response.
response.externalCapacitorTransfer: Additional first-order RC: H(s)=1/(1+s*32000*C). Buffer and ADC drive requirements remain separate.
response.simulationContract: Do not replace this part's internal response by the reference 5.1 kHz envelope. Measured full sensor/frame/conditioning transfer or separately labeled conservative screening envelopes are required.

conditioningExample.meaning: Bipolar centered gain around V1P8ANA/2, with the amplifier on suitable rails. This is a gain/range design example, not clipping qualification.

calibration.biasTemperatureTableNote: The Rev D ADXL354 typical entry is +/-0.2 mg/C between limits +/-0.15; this internally inconsistent typical entry is not used here.
calibration.ratiometric: Output sensitivity and zero reference are relative to V1P8ANA, not an arbitrary external ADC reference.

price.observation: Latest regional indexed result. Earlier EU cache showed 55.38/48.90 EUR and 32 stock. Regional pages can also report restricted availability; these are indicative observations. Mouser regional terms exclude VAT.

candidates.role: Industrial 3-axis digital vibration candidate; generous bandwidth but materially greater noise and incomplete phase specification
candidates.noiseDensityConditions: All three axes enabled, 100 Hz to 6.3 kHz, independent of selected full scale. Min/max are 3-sigma limited-sample characterization, not guaranteed production bounds. Single-axis noise specifications cannot be used for two simultaneous planar axes.

response.configuration: LPF2 bypassed, high-pass disabled; normal LPF1 chain remains active.
response.simulationContract: A 6.3 kHz magnitude point is not a disclosed low-pass order. Screen guessed phase separately, identify the physical impulse/group delay before calling a result component-qualified.

interfaceTiming.syncContract: Capture DRDY on the MCU's force-ADC clock, calibrate sensor clock drift and reconstruct timestamp alignment. No same-clock or complete analog-delay guarantee follows from internal timestamps. Avoid FIFO batches that add many sample intervals.

calibration.interpretation: Temperature scale figures cover the range relative to 25 C; they are not per-degree coefficients.

price.package: LGA-14, reel part sold as cut tape
price.observation: Latest regional indexed result, crawled the previous day. Older Netherlands cache showed 17.55/15.42 EUR; not used as the primary comparison. Mouser regional terms exclude VAT.

candidates.role: Largest plausible cost reduction: 3-axis digital acceleration; high-rate phase/noise identification and supply availability required
candidates.noiseDensityConditions: Typical density at 10 Hz. Manufacturer 0.65/0.70 mg RMS at 100 Hz is a calculated figure. Neither specifies actual high-rate assembled sanding PSD.

highResolutionFIFO.meaning: Use the manufacturer's 18-bit sensitivity after proper packet unpacking; an apparent 20-bit packet is not 20 acceleration bits.

response.internalPath: ADC/common decimation to 32 kHz, configurable second-order AAF, UI filtering, interface.
response.tableInterpretation: At 32/16/8/4/2 kHz the table cells are merged across all UI bandwidth and filter-order settings. Selecting a first-order UI register does not make the full common-decimator chain a first-order RC. Group-delay table does not disclose the complete common/AAF impulse response or a worst-case bound.

interfaceTiming.externalClockRateRule: Output rates scale by CLKIN/32000, per section 12.5.
interfaceTiming.proposedFilterClockScalingStatus: Frequency and group-delay inverse scaling are inferred if the common/filter clocks share CLKIN; the explicit guaranteed statement is output-rate scaling. Validate measured full response, not just output frequency.
interfaceTiming.timestampRule: At external RTC clock the 1-us FIFO timestamps need the section 12.7 RTC-frequency scaling. Capture DRDY and map force-sampling timestamps; CLKIN alone does not align analog group delays.
interfaceTiming.invalidExample: 30 kHz CLKIN is below the 31 kHz minimum.

response.internalAnalogFilterDescription: Same mechanical/analog sinc chain as ADXL354; additional digital decimation and optional interpolation.
response.delayMeaning: Delay from ADC input to interface, excluding preceding mechanical/analog response. It is the largest component but not the complete physical sensor delay.

price.observation: Cached current page reports both stock and restricted/last-stock warnings. Earlier French 58.65/52.21 EUR cache is not the primary comparison. Mouser regional terms exclude VAT.

briefComparator.reasonNotPrioritized: Cheaper, but high-rate UI response is incompletely specified; the documented fastest OIS response is too slow to offer a clear advantage over the selected fast digital candidates.
briefComparator.highRateUIWarning: The ODR/2 LPF1 rule is documented only through 833 Hz; do not infer a 3333.5 Hz cutoff at 6667 Hz ODR.

inferenceInputs.sharpBumpJerkMeaning: Analytical matched C2 compact bump h*(1-u^2)^3 over a 100 ms crossing: endpoint one-sided jerk is 384 m/s^3. Actual closed-loop S acceleration and compensation sensitivity must come from native histories; this is not a pass/fail bound.
inferenceInputs.budgetMeaning: Flat-white density integration and first-order small-time mismatch estimates are transparent analytical calculations. Neither proves native control performance, impulse response, noise autocorrelation, assembled vibration, clipping, calibration residuals or phase matching.
